name: Configure the Lustre client for EFA, wait for the file system, and mount it at /fsx

tasks.name: configure the Lustre client for EFA (optimized for GDS) while the file system is created
commands: modinfo lustre > $D/modinfo-lustre.txt 2>&1 || { echo 'no Lustre client on this AMI'; exit 1; }

tasks.name: wait until the file system is AVAILABLE
commands: for i in $(seq 1 120); do aws lambda invoke --function-name $FSX_FUNCTION --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out --payload '{"action":"describe"}' $D/describe.json > /dev/null; S=$(python3 -c 'import json;print(json.load(open("'$D'/describe.json"))["state"])'); echo "$(date -Is) $S"; [ "$S" = AVAILABLE ] && break; [ "$S" = ABSENT ] && exit 1; sleep 30; done

tasks.name: mount at /fsx and confirm the EFA peers
commands: N=$(grep -c '@efa' $D/lnet-peer.txt || true); echo "efa peers: $N" | tee $D/efa-peer-count.txt; [ "$N" -gt 0 ] || echo '[WARNING] no @efa peer: Lustre traffic is on TCP, so GDS over EFA cannot be measured' | tee -a $D/efa-peer-count.txt
